entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. My name is VeloBot. How may I assist you today?
Yes, I'm calling about the VeloBand Pulse I received. I want to return it, but I'm getting an error saying the return window has closed.
I understand your frustration. Let me pull up your account information. Can you please provide the order number or the email address associated with the purchase?
It's under my email: sarah.miller@email.com. The thing is, this VeloBand Pulse *was a gift* from my brother. I didn't even know I was getting it!

Thank you, Sarah. I see the order here. I understand it *was a gift*. The return window for the VeloBand Pulse is typically 10 days from the date of delivery. I see it was delivered on August 1st, making the return window close on August 11th. Today is August 20th.

But that's the problem! I *didn't open it* right away. I was *traveling* internationally for work the day after I received it. I literally just got back and unpacked it yesterday! Also, I think the *website crashed* when I tried to request the return earlier.

I sincerely apologize for the inconvenience, Sarah, and I appreciate you explaining the situation. *Traveling* internationally can certainly throw things off. I also understand your concern about the website. While I can't confirm the crash right now, I am very sorry for any inconvenience this may have caused. I do see that the standard return policy is 10 days, and that is mentioned in the *fine print* on the order confirmation email. Unfortunately, this is automatically enforced by our system, but let me see if there is something I can do.
One moment, please. I am going to speak with my supervisor and see if we can make an exception, especially considering it *was a gift* and you *didn't open it* until recently.

Thank you. I would really appreciate that. I almost ended up in the *hospital* a few months ago from a racing heart, and I was hoping this would help me stay on top of my vitals, but it's just not for me.

Sarah, I have good news. My supervisor has approved a one-time exception to our return policy in your case. We will process your return for the VeloBand Pulse. I have emailed you a prepaid shipping label. Please package the item securely and ship it back to us within the next 5 business days.

Oh, that's fantastic! Thank you so much! You have no idea how much stress this has taken off me. I saw the *fine print* about the 10 days, but I was really hoping you guys could help me out. You're the best!
You're very welcome, Sarah. We strive to provide excellent customer service here at VeloFit. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Thank you again for your help!
Have a great day, Sarah, and thank you for choosing VeloFit!
